title: [Rust] Exceeding the attribute-id cap silently drops every property on the node and still reports success
body:
## Summary

When a `CREATE` introduces more distinct attribute names than the graph's attribute-id space can hold, the Rust engine (`falkordb/falkordb:edge`) reports **success** and creates the node with **zero properties** — not just the overflowing ones, *all* of them. The C engine returns a clean error and creates nothing.

Found while triaging #2331 against Rust. The security substance of #233
